title: deploy: release pins k8s/values.yaml but ArgoCD does not read this repo; tags still bumped by hand in home-systems budget.yaml
notes:
Found during v2026.11.21: release.yml deploy job rewrote k8s/values.yaml to 2026.11.21 but the budget Application's sources are only home-systems + temporal chart (the budget-repo values source is commented out at home-systems k8s/applications/budget.yaml ~line 57, waiting on an ArgoCD read credential). Pods stayed on 2026.11.20 until home-systems ad930b76 bumped the four tags by hand. Fix: enable the budget repo source in home-systems, or have release.yml bump home-systems.
Added read-only deploy key (id 170702197, derived from argocd-budget secret) to yurifrl/budget; ArgoCD repo connection Successful. home-systems 6d6fe375 enables the budget ref:values source + valueFiles. App Synced/Healthy with revisions [6d6fe375, 1.8.0, aab4aa9]; deployments still 2026.11.21. Local helm render shows imageTags from values file win over inline tags. Docs updated (eca122e).
Fixed: read-only deploy key added on yurifrl/budget; home-systems 6d6fe375 enables the budget-repo values source so release.yml's k8s/values.yaml pin rolls prod. Verified Synced/Healthy, 3 sources, pods stay 2026.11.21, helm template shows values.yaml tags win. Docs eca122e merged into local main (not pushed; local main also carries unpushed i18n work from another session). Evidence attached on task.
